info.title: AI Notes API
info.description: Notes API with semantic search (pgvector embeddings) and AI summaries. Get a token from `POST /api/auth/register` or `POST /api/auth/login`, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Rate limits: 60 req/min per user, 20 req/min for AI endpoints (search, summary), 5 login attempts/min per email.

post.summary: Register a new account and return an API token
Log in with email + password and return an API token
Revoke the token used for this request

get.summary: List the user's notes, newest first, paginated with `page` and `limit`

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Create a note. Its embedding is generated in the background

put.summary: Update a note's title and/or content. Clears its summary and re-indexes it

get.summary:
Semantic search: embed the query and rank the user's notes by cosine
similarity (pgvector HNSW index). Matches meaning, not just keywords

pending_index.description: Notes still waiting for an embedding are not searchable yet.

post.description:
The summary is stored on the note and returned as-is on later calls
(`cached: true`) until the note's text changes. Pass `refresh=true`
to force a new one. Returns 409 if the note was edited while the summary was
being generated, and 503 if the AI provider is unavailable.
post.summary: Generate an AI summary of the note

model.description: Which model wrote it: the chat model, or "local-extractive" for the offline driver.

message.const: The note changed while its summary was being generated. Please try again.

is_indexed.description: Whether the note has an embedding yet (it is generated on a background queue).

score.description: Cosine similarity to the query, 0..1. Only present in search results.
